description: 0.3.0 causal architecture: arrows carry the named information/action from source to recipient. contracts.label: request
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Natural-language part intent.
contracts.effects: Conversation only.
contracts.failure: Ask for missing intent.
contracts.excludes: No physical confirmation on behalf of the user.

contracts.label: interact / confirm
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: User UI actions.
contracts.effects: Studio private UI state; part commands use studio-commands.
contracts.failure: Show errors without hiding the previous valid view.
contracts.excludes: Agent messages are not user confirmation.

contracts.label: geometry API
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Explicit geometry values, assets, parameters and tolerance.
contracts.effects: Local scratch computation only.
contracts.failure: Unsupported or invalid geometry is explicit.
contracts.excludes: Cannot persist into a bundle or invoke Slice-private geometry.

contracts.label: toolpath API
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Explicit Inject, Trace or Slice requests, geometry values and machine/process snapshot.
contracts.effects: Local scratch computation only.
contracts.failure: Return construction diagnostics.
contracts.excludes: Cannot export, confirm or mutate a bundle.

contracts.label: discover / author
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Extension identity or builder-authorized definition edits.
contracts.outputs: Extension definitions and identity; maker guidance is read through 1.
contracts.effects: Library owns its storage; builder edits are preserved separately from release updates.
contracts.failure: Report missing extensions and edit conflicts.
contracts.excludes: Maker cannot author; installed defaults never silently overwrite local edits.

contracts.label: open / switch bundle
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Bundle and Studio-instance identity; requested active-bundle selection.
contracts.outputs: Selected bundle identity and access status.
contracts.effects: Select the active bundle while preserving instance ownership; no direct part-content edits.
contracts.failure: Reject stale revisions or writes without the active instance edit ownership; keep other viewers read-only.
contracts.excludes: Geometry, toolpath and settings changes use their owning interfaces; no user confirmation or arbitrary bundle writes.

contracts.label: commands
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Owner/Studio-instance and bundle identity, expected revision, and typed edit/open/build command.
contracts.effects: 5 owns shared part state and grants edit ownership to only one Studio instance per bundle; an agent may own multiple instances.
contracts.failure: Reject stale revisions or writes without the active instance edit ownership; keep other viewers read-only.
contracts.excludes: No direct engine or bundle-file access.

contracts.label: current SAAMpath/settings
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Bundle/owner identity and expected displayed revision; then checked program and matching snapshot identity.
contracts.outputs: Immutable current SAAMpath, geometry/dependency identity, machine/setup and output options; accepted export record or conflict.
contracts.effects: 5 supplies the current snapshot and accepts checked export records through the declared access; 8 cannot regenerate.
contracts.failure: Reject queued updates, stale revisions, unavailable paths and superseded results before releasing the export.
contracts.excludes: No build request, regeneration, direct bundle-file access or separate user approval step.

contracts.label: snapshot / events
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Immutable revisioned part view and event cursor, including saved geometry and any saved toolpath.
contracts.effects: Subscription state remains in owner; Studio renders its own projection.
contracts.failure: Recover missed events by snapshot; missing extension dependencies block regeneration, not inspection of available saved artifacts.
contracts.excludes: No shared mutable object references.

contracts.label: build status
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Job/revision identity, progress, diagnostics and preview artifacts.
contracts.effects: Private render caches only.
contracts.failure: Ignore obsolete jobs; retain last valid artifacts.
contracts.excludes: No UI access to worker internals.

contracts.label: review identity
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Current geometry/settings/path identity, pending-update state and export result.
contracts.outputs: Visible review and export availability; hide Export as soon as an update is queued, using the waiting indicators’ same pending-update state.
contracts.effects: Private render state only.
contracts.failure: Pending or changed identity immediately removes export availability.
contracts.excludes: Preview does not count as confirmation.

contracts.label: render view
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Immutable view and diagnostics.
contracts.effects: Studio-private state only.
contracts.failure: Show errors with revision identity.
contracts.excludes: Does not mutate bundle.

contracts.label: generation request
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Expected revision and complete bundle snapshot.
contracts.effects: State internal to component 5.
contracts.failure: Obsolete jobs cannot replace current state.
contracts.excludes: No access to unrelated component internals.

contracts.label: built artifact
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.

contracts.outputs: Current review snapshot; prior export invalidation.
contracts.effects: State internal to component 5.
contracts.failure: Any identity change invalidates confirmation.
contracts.excludes: No access to unrelated component internals.

contracts.label: geometry + SAAMpath
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
operations: Prepare one geometry/deposition recipe proposal or execute the recipe to SAAMpath; Bundle owns revision checks and atomic acceptance.
contracts.inputs: Immutable bundle snapshot, pinned extensions/assets, machine/setup and cancellation signal.
contracts.outputs: Geometry, SAAMpath and diagnostics returned by engine 3; bundle 5 accepts/stores them.
contracts.effects: 3 owns engine computation; 5 owns job acceptance and commits the returned result.
contracts.failure: Missing generation dependencies or failure/cancellation leave saved geometry and toolpath viewable; 5 preserves previous valid artifacts.
contracts.excludes: 3 cannot write the bundle, confirm or deliver.

contracts.label: geometry values
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Authored geometry definitions and pinned assets.
contracts.effects: No shared mutation; returns owned values.
contracts.failure: Return a structured error; no partial commit.
contracts.excludes: No access to unrelated component internals.

contracts.label: extension construction values

contracts.inputs: Resolved extension identity, immutable inputs and engine capability object.
contracts.effects: Extension-local state and declared resource IO through 4.3; cached/pinned assets are preferred for reproducibility.
contracts.failure: Missing dependencies stop this generation with an actionable error; migration guidance handles actual engine breaks.
contracts.excludes: No bundle/Studio internals, hidden IO or confirmation authority.

contracts.label: resolve exact version
contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
contracts.inputs: Bundle-declared extension identity and local library selection.
contracts.outputs: Script/guidance package and assets with recorded identity.
contracts.effects: Library may cache exclusively owned content.
contracts.failure: Report missing dependencies; breaking engine changes get migration guidance when needed.
contracts.excludes: No silent latest-version substitution.

contracts.direction: Causal flow: named information or action passes from source to recipient. Permitted calls/reads are listed separately in access.
